purpose: Prefer confident same-class outer heavy-vehicle boxes, then suppress contained low-confidence heavy-vehicle candidates; no extra cross-class high-confidence merging.
selection_basis: One structural revision after v1 lost a matched full bus and kept an unmatched high-score front fragment on reused Validation. Geometry thresholds unchanged; no further threshold search.
scope: Current validation pilot; not automatically deployed to full-video batch.
limitations: Heavy vehicles from distinct physical objects can overlap.
Disjoint front/rear fragments are deliberately not forced into one object.
Counts are model estimates; no new manual labels or count ground truth.
